minutes.headline: Planning Board voted to draft a town meeting article striking the WHM overlay and backed preserving Lanny Orchards.
minutes.summary: The board backed the state's agricultural preservation purchase of Lanny Orchards on Chase Road and approved revised special permit and site plan rules after a public hearing no member of the public attended. It endorsed a letter to the zoning board on a cluster development request and voted to draft an article for the August special town meeting striking the WHM overlay district. Committee reports touched on stormwater basin maintenance and the use table.

what_happened.line: The board voted to draft an article for the special town meeting striking the WHM overlay district, pending a better use for the area.
The board voted to support state acquisition of the Lanny Orchards agricultural preservation restriction on Chase Road.
After a public hearing with no public attendance, the board approved revised special permit and site plan rules, excluding the application page.
The board endorsed the June 27 letter to the zoning board of appeals on the Highfield Village request, with the Conservation Commission to be copied.
The submission checklist was kept out of the rules as an administrative document, to be finalized by the end of next month.

why_it_matters: Striking the WHM overlay district would change the zoning on that area, and residents at the special town meeting would be asked to vote on the article.
The Lanny Orchards recommendation bears on whether the farmland is preserved and on the town's share of the cost, which comes from the town budget, mostly taxes.
The revised special permit and site plan rules set the process that developers and residents follow for future projects.
